_meta.openai/widgetDescription: A finished OffStereo story prepared for an honest, private Save to Spotify handoff on the listener's computer.

description: Prepare one finished OffStereo story to become a private Spotify episode after the listener explicitly asks. OffStereo packages its completed intro, ordered narration, sign-off, branded title, show notes, OffStereo cover, chapters, and song timeline, then returns an honest handoff: the episode is not in Spotify until the listener finishes with Spotify's Save to Spotify helper on their own computer. Use the active or selected story's sessionId. This is for a narrated story, not a playlist or an unfinished build.

sessionId.description: The completed OffStereo story id from the active player or the listener's library.

name: prepare_episode

outputSchema.description: A prepared Spotify episode handoff bundle. OffStereo produces the finished audio and metadata; the episode is not in Spotify until the listener completes the save on their own computer.

desktopHandoff.description: A ready-to-forward request for a desktop agent to finish the private save.
